title: The same drawing, twice
note: The Tusi couple: a small circle rolling inside a big one traces a straight line, and the same drawing turns up in Copernicus 300 years later with no credit.

beats.sub: an astronomer called Nasir al-Din al-Tusi

beats.call: Roll a small circle inside a big one
beats.callsub: the big circle is twice as wide

beats.call: One point on it moves dead straight
beats.callsub: circles only, and yet a straight line

beats.sub: the sky was supposed to move in circles

beats.callsub: the same drawing, in his own book

beats.call: Drawn in exactly the same way
beats.callsub: and no mention of al-Tusi anywhere

beats.text: Did it travel, or was it found twice?
